state.passage: The graph above shows the percentages of women employed behind the scenes on the top 100 U.S. films by role in 2020, 2021, and 2022.
state.visual_description: A grouped vertical bar graph titled “Percentages of Women Employed Behind the Scenes on Top 100 U.S. Films by Role in 2020, 2021, and 2022.” The vertical axis is labeled “(%)” and has labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. The horizontal axis is labeled “(Role)” and lists Director, Writer, Editor, and Producer from left to right. answer.instructions: `question`의 요구에 따라 주어진 지문과 자료를 읽고 정답 하나를 선택하세요. 내용이 일치하지 않는 것, 어법상 틀린 것 등 문항의 긍정·부정 조건에 주의하세요. 지문에 ①~⑤ 또는 (a)~(e)가 있으면 원문의 위치·밑줄을 가리키는 표시입니다. 반환할 답은 현재 제시된 선택지 A~E 중 해당하는 키입니다. 추가 해설이나 힌트 없이 주어진 내용으로 문항을 풀어야 합니다.

criteria.A: For each of the three years, the percentage of women employed as producers on the top 100 U.S. films was the highest as compared with the percentages of each of the other three roles.
criteria.B: The percentage of women employed as directors on the top 100 U.S. films in 2021 was lower than in 2020 but higher than in 2022.
criteria.C: The percentage of women employed as writers on the top 100 U.S. films increased by 4 percentage points from 2020 to 2021 and by 1 percentage point from 2021 to 2022.
criteria.D: The percentage of women employed as editors on the top 100 U.S. films was less than 20% in each of the three years.
criteria.E: In 2022, the percentage of women employed as producers on the top 100 U.S. films was the same as that in 2020.
